title.zh: 卷三十九 志第十五 曆九
title.raw: 卷三十九 志第十五 曆九 Volume 39 Treatises 15: Calendar 9

translations.idiomatic: ▲ The Islamic Calendar Method, Part Three

sentences.zh: 土星黃道南北緯度立成上橫行，以小輪心定度爲引數，起五十度，異累加三度。

translations.literal: On the upper horizontal row of the ready-made table for Saturn's north and south ecliptic latitude, the epicycle-center fixed degree serves as the argument, starting at fifty degrees; each successive entry adds three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the top row of the precomputed table for Saturn's ecliptic latitude north and south of the ecliptic, the argument is the degree fixed at the epicycle center, beginning at fifty degrees; each successive entry adds three degrees.

translations.literal: Each successive addition is three degrees.

sentences.zh: 首直行以自行定度爲引數，累加十度。

translations.literal: The first vertical column takes the planet's own fixed degree as the argument, with each successive addition of ten degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the first vertical column, the argument is the planet's own mean longitude, and each successive entry adds ten degrees.

sentences.zh: 求法：簡兩引數近度，縱橫相遇度分，次各用比例法，得細率。

translations.literal: Method of calculation: select the two arguments nearest in degree, find where the row and column meet in degrees and minutes, then apply proportional interpolation to each in turn to obtain the fine rate.
translations.idiomatic: To calculate: take the two nearest argument values, find the degrees and minutes where the row and column intersect, then apply proportional interpolation to each in turn to obtain the refined rate.
